name: MonarchChartLegend
title: ChartLegend
summary: The names and colors of a chart's series in the theme's data slots, as a plain list or as toggle chips that show and hide each series, with a Show all reset.
whenToUse: Under or beside a chart with two or more series, so each line, bar or area has a visible name. Use the toggle form when people compare series and need to hide some.
whenNotToUse: For a chart with one series, name it in the title instead. For filters that change the data rather than its display, use MonarchTag or segmented buttons.
api: @Composable fun MonarchChartLegend(items: List<MonarchChartLegendItem>, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, marker: MonarchChartLegendMarker = MonarchChartLegendMarker.Line, orientation: Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal, enabled: Boolean = true, legendLabel: String? = null)

@Composable fun MonarchChartLegend(items: List<MonarchChartLegendItem>, hiddenSeries: Set<String>, onHiddenSeriesChange: (Set<String>) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, marker: MonarchChartLegendMarker = MonarchChartLegendMarker.Line, orientation: Orientation = Orientation.Horizontal, enabled: Boolean = true, keepOneVisible: Boolean = true, showAllButton: Boolean = true, legendLabel: String? = null, showAllLabel: String? = null, shownLabel: String? = null, hiddenLabel: String? = null)
class MonarchChartLegendItem(key: String, label: String, color: MonarchChartColor? = null, dashed: Boolean = false, value: String? = null)
enum class MonarchChartColor { Data1, Data2, Data3, Data4, Data5, Neutral }
enum class MonarchChartLegendMarker { Line, Square, Dot }

options.name: items
options.description: The entries in series order: key, label, optional palette slot, dashed flag and formatted value.

options.name: hiddenSeries
options.description: The keys of the hidden series. Passing it selects the toggle overload. Keys the legend does not list are kept.

options.name: onHiddenSeriesChange
options.description: Called with the new hidden set after a toggle or Show all.

options.name: marker
options.description: Line, Square or Dot; use the shape the chart draws.

options.name: orientation
options.description: Horizontal wraps entries onto new rows; Vertical stacks them with values at the end.

options.name: enabled
options.description: False draws markers and text in the disabled color; toggles ignore taps.

options.name: keepOneVisible
options.description: Toggle overload: the last shown series ignores the tap, so the chart is never blank.

options.name: showAllButton
options.description: Toggle overload: shows Show all while one of the legend's series is hidden.

options.name: showAllLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in button text "Show all" (monarch_chartlegend_show_all).

states.name: shown
states.description: The marker in the series color and the label in the default text color; a toggle is selected with the state "Shown".

states.name: hidden
states.description: Toggles only: the marker in the disabled text color, the label muted and struck through, the state "Hidden".

states.name: locked
states.description: Toggles only: with keepOneVisible the last shown series ignores the tap.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Markers and text in the disabled text color; toggles do not respond.

appearance: Markers use the theme's data colors data1 to data5 in entry order, then the subtle text color for neutral entries; hidden or disabled markers use the disabled text color. Labels use the default text color, muted when hidden; values the default text color in medium weight. Toggle chips have no fill or border of their own, only the Material pressed ripple. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: Material 3 has no legend, so Monarch builds one; toggle entries are Material 3 FilterChips, as the plan asked. The web legend becomes a toolbar with one Tab stop and arrow keys and reports the hovered entry through onActiveChange; on Android each toggle is its own TalkBack element and there is no hover, so neither is offered, as on iOS. The web is controlled or uncontrolled (defaultHiddenSeries); here state is hoisted, a Set<String> where iOS uses a Binding. The web's toggleable flag is the choice of overload. The web messages.entry spoken-name builder is not offered: a toggle is read as its label and value with its state. The web marks the locked entry aria-disabled; here, as on iOS, the tap is ignored. Same names as iOS: MonarchChartLegendItem, MonarchChartColor, MonarchChartLegendMarker; axis is orientation (the Compose Orientation).
accessibility: The legend is a traversal group named "Legend" (or legendLabel).
A plain entry is one element read as its label and its value; the marker is drawn on a Canvas without semantics.
A toggle entry is a Material 3 FilterChip: selected while its series is shown, with the state description "Shown" or "Hidden".
A hidden series is shown by a struck-through, muted label and a grey marker, not by color alone.
Toggle entries and the Show all button have touch targets of at least 48dp and follow the layout direction.
Labels wrap at font scale 2.0 instead of being cut.
edgeCases: From the sixth entry on, entries without a color are neutral; fold extra series into "Other" or split the chart.
Keys in hiddenSeries that the legend does not list stay hidden after Show all, so several legends can share one set.
A locked entry gives no spoken feedback when tapped; this was not checked with TalkBack on a device.
Long labels wrap and the row wraps onto new rows.

examples.title: Plain legend with values
examples.template:
MonarchChartLegend(
    items = listOf(
        MonarchChartLegendItem({{items.0.key}}, {{items.0.label}}, color = MonarchChartColor.Data1, value = {{items.0.value}}),
        MonarchChartLegendItem({{items.1.key}}, {{items.1.label}}, color = MonarchChartColor.Data2, value = {{items.1.value}}),
        MonarchChartLegendItem({{items.2.key}}, {{items.2.label}}, color = MonarchChartColor.Data3, value = {{items.2.value}}),
    ),
    marker = MonarchChartLegendMarker.{{marker|pascal}},
)
examples.code:
MonarchChartLegend(
    items = listOf(
        MonarchChartLegendItem("web", "Web", color = MonarchChartColor.Data1, value = "12,480"),
        MonarchChartLegendItem("ios", "iOS", color = MonarchChartColor.Data2, value = "8,210"),
        MonarchChartLegendItem("android", "Android", color = MonarchChartColor.Data3, value = "6,975"),
    ),
    marker = MonarchChartLegendMarker.Square,
)

examples.title: Toggles that hide series
examples.code:
MonarchChartLegend(
    items = listOf(
        MonarchChartLegendItem("web", "Web"),
        MonarchChartLegendItem("ios", "iOS"),
        MonarchChartLegendItem("android", "Android"),
    ),
    hiddenSeries = hidden,
    onHiddenSeriesChange = { hidden = it },
    marker = MonarchChartLegendMarker.Square,
)
